events.title: Update 1.04
events.summary: I am happy to announce a new update!Updates based on player feedback:When replaying a location, empty chests will now contain random items. If items do not appear immediately, complete the location, they will appear on subsequent playthroughs.An option to lock the cursor within the game window has been added useful for those playing with a dual-monitor setup.It is now possible to remove a rune socketed into an item. events.title: Update 1.03 Character Body Editor
events.summary: I am pleased to present the Elven Huntress: Sunveil update!By popular request, body sliders have been added to the character editor.Now your character can be more unique and tailored to your preferences. A small addition: if you enter the character editor during gameplay from the manor, you now have the option to cancel changes.This is to prevent unintentional changes to your character's current appearance.Thank you all for your feedback and support! They help make Elven Huntress: Sunveil better

events.title: Update 1.02 Alternative Controls
events.summary: I’m happy to present the second update for Elven Huntress: Sunveil!Based on player feedback, the melee combat control system has been reworked.Now during combat, your character attacks the nearest enemy in the direction of movement, regardless of camera position. events.title: The Elven Huntress: Sunveil demo is now available!
events.summary: Everyone can begin their first adventure in the world of Sunveil.Create your character, discover the core gameplay systems, and set out on your journey.The demo includes the character creator, the first playable location, and character progression up to level 6.I would be happy to hear your feedback and suggestions. They will help make Elven Huntress: Sunveil even better.Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

events.title: The Elven Huntress: Sunveil playtest has come to an end!
events.summary: The Elven Huntress: Sunveil playtest is over, and I would like to thank everyone who joined me on this small adventure.Thank you for your feedback and suggestions. They will help make Elven Huntress: Sunveil even better.New locations, even more equipment, and the continuation of your journey await you.Add the game to your wishlist to follow development updates and not miss the release.Thank you for your support!

events.title: Launching Playtest
events.summary: The Elven Huntress: Sunveil playtest is now available!Anyone can request access and try the game before release.Access requests are usually approved within 24 hours.The playtest will run until June 8.What awaits you:The first playable locationBattles against orcs, humans, and undeadLoot, equipment, and character progressionExploration of the world of SunveilCore combat and progression systemsThank you all for supporting the project and participating in the playtest!
